result.brief: 提出统一世界动作模型 P³-WAM，以共享权重的混合 Transformer 将结构化 3D 动作表征注入预训练视频扩散模型，实现感知、动作条件未来预测与目标导向规划三模式联合训练。
result.reason: Unified world action model with action-conditioned video prediction, 3D action representation injected into video diffusion transformer, and egocentric dexterous manipulation planning.
